Case 1: A selected → C selected, B not selected. Choose 2 more from remaining 5: \(\binom{5}{2}=10\).

Case 2: A not selected → C not selected. Choose 4 from remaining 6: \(\binom{6}{4}=15\).

Total selections: \(10+15=25\).

Dispatch plans: \(25 \cdot 4! = 25 \cdot 24 = 600\).

\boxed{600}
